externalReply.text: Leena, Nia Chen owns this case and will update you by 16:30 UTC today, then send a consolidated board-packet status by May 19 at 10:30. Classic remains active under your paid term through June 30. The evidence shows a December message reached a server, not that you read it or that the notice question is settled. Counsel is reviewing that question and the older assurance, with an initial written position due May 19 at 10:00.

An approved offer is available to continue Classic, including the existing offline signing workflow and security maintenance, from July 1 through August 31 at no added charge. It covers your current 128-user limit and has no new features or service beyond August. It requires your written acceptance by May 23 at 17:00 and activation verification; it is not active yet. It requires no annual Flow purchase or release of your complaint. The internal planning slot is reserved provisionally, with confirmation due today. The retained export workspace would run through September 30 if you accept.

Flow currently lacks offline signing and native Classic amendment lineage; a separate signed-event archive is different from equivalent Flow history. No roadmap target is a July delivery promise. Your authorized export to the existing secure workspace is being started, targeting May 20 at 16:00 with a progress update if checks fail. Northstar can provide up to sixteen assistance hours whether you stay or choose another provider. That covers staff work, not a cash payment or a guarantee about another system. No production conversion, partner upload or new subscription will occur without the required permission. The team can meet May 19 at 09:00 to compare the bridge and destination choices; please confirm whether that time works.
